stem.text: Which statement about these nuclei is correct?

A.text: An uncharged atom of element Q has 24 orbital electrons.

B.text: Nuclei G and M are isotopes of the same element.

C.text: When E absorbs a neutron and then emits an $\alpha$-particle, E transforms into M.

D.text: When M emits a $\beta^{-}$ particle, M transforms into Q.
